name: sgs/site-header
title: SGS Site Header
description: The site header shell — three optional rows (top / middle / bottom) of header elements. Each row is an intrinsic never-overflow cluster, so the header never overflows the viewport at any width. Lives inside the header template part.

sgs._comment_overlayNotAdopted: backgroundOverlayColour/Opacity/OpacityTablet/OpacityMobile/ColourHover/BlendMode are the shared whole-block BACKGROUND PANEL (rendered by class-sgs-container-wrapper.php's sgs_overlay_decls()), not media elements -- same reasoning as sgs/container (see its block.json for the full note). Detector rule 37-media-no-handroll's bare `background`/`bg`-prefix discriminator excludes this whole family from supports.sgs.mediaElements by design.

text.reason: A text gradient needs background-clip:text, which hijacks the element's own background box. On the header WRAPPER that would destroy the header background this same block paints. The mechanism is only valid on a leaf text element; this row colours the whole bar.

wrapper.label: Section wrapper
wrapper._note: The rendered <header>/<div> element (containerKind=section, rendered through SGS_Container_Wrapper per the composite-mirror rule R-31-9). Colour, spacing and border are SGS-owned attributes (see attrMap), each emitted into this block's own scoped <style> rather than inline (Spec 32). The typography members are honest GAPs: this block declares no `supports.typography` and no font-* attributes. anim:preset/easing/stagger/trigger are honest GAPs too (no sgsAnimation*/stagger attributes); bgKenBurns is a Ken-Burns preset toggle with no animation-cluster member, so it stays unmapped exactly as on sgs/container.

inner.label: Inner (grid / flex layout)
inner._note: Arrangement members map explicitly because this element declares no `prefix`. css:grid-template-columns maps to the `columns` COUNT attribute (SGS_Container_Wrapper expands it to repeat(N,1fr)) — this block has no explicit gridTemplateColumns ratio attribute, unlike sgs/container. css:align-items maps to `alignItems` (class-sgs-container-wrapper.php reads alignItems||alignItems). display / justify-items / order / overflow / grid-template-rows / grid-auto-rows have no attribute on this block and remain honest GAPs.

decorative.label: Decorative background
decorative._note: Background image/video (backgroundImage*/bgVideo*), background SVG (bgSvg*), overlay gradient (overlayGradient*/backgroundOverlay*), Ken Burns, and shape dividers (shapeDivider*) are governed by dedicated controls outside the Text/Fill/Layout style clusters, so this element declares none. Mirrors sgs/container's `decorative` element.

headerPassThrough.description: Float over the page, per device tier (tri-state on/off/inherit): the header is position:fixed (takes no space, pinned under the admin bar), and only its structure lets clicks through to the page; every block in it keeps its clicks. Wave 3C U-14, family M-52.

headerFloat.description: Floating "pill" mode per device tier — the same tri-state {desktop,tablet,mobile} of on/off/inherit as headerSticky. Float ON for a tier implies the sticky declaration for that tier (precedence Float > Sticky > Transparent for position/top/z-index). Empty = off everywhere, and nothing is emitted.

headerFloatInset.description: TIER-of-BOX gap between the pill and the viewport edges: {desktop:{top,right,left}, tablet:{…}, mobile:{…}}. Relative units, not px — a bare px inset fails WCAG 1.4.4 at 200% zoom. `bottom` is unused and is not offered in the UI. Each side is resolved as max(authored, env(safe-area-inset-*)).

headerFloatCollapse.description: The single opt-out from the pill: below `breakpoint` the header goes full width, radius 0, inset 0. OFF by default — the pill persists at mobile. Deliberately one toggle plus one number, never three per-tier switches.

surfaceBlur.description: Backdrop blur: a single CSS length (for example 24px) that blurs whatever sits behind the header. Emitted by SGS_Container_Wrapper via includes/helpers-surface-ground.php; empty emits nothing.

surfaceSaturate.description: Backdrop saturation as a whole-number percentage (for example 150), paired with surfaceBlur. Unset emits nothing; 0 is a legal value.

surfaceOpacity.description: Fill translucency, 0 to 1: how much of the header's own colour shows. Applies to a plain colour fill only (a gradient fill is left as it is). Unset or 1 emits nothing.

zIndex.description: Stacking order per tier: {desktop, tablet, mobile}, each a whole number from 0 to 99998, or empty to inherit the wider tier (the framework default is 100). The drawer and its scrim are kept just below the header, which needs a value of 4 or more. Written only by includes/sgs-header-z-index.php.

shadowScrolled.description: Box-shadow SHAPE (or theme shadow preset slug) the header takes once the page has scrolled. Same value vocabulary as `shadow`. Empty = no scrolled shadow, nothing emitted.

shadowScrolledColour.description: Colour composed into the scrolled shadow SHAPE (a token slug or raw colour). Ignored when shadowScrolled is a preset slug.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over borderColour.
